_about: Hand-picked reviews quoted from the 租八借 (D.B.K. Rentals) listing on Google Maps, harvested 2026-09-12 via the Google Search reviews dialog, sorted by Google's 'most relevant'. 60 of 125 read; 47 were 4-5 stars with text. 'when' is the relative date Google showed on 2026-09-12. 'lang' is the language the reviewer wrote in; the other-language field is our translation. Text is verbatim except where 'trimmed' is true.

reviews.name: Cindy Lin
reviews.zh: 天使般的老闆娘跟老闆，非常親切不是只是做生意，是真的關心！超級愛
reviews.en: The owner and his wife are angels — genuinely warm, not just doing business but actually caring. Love this place!

reviews.name: YO去旅行 LO
reviews.zh: 裝備豐富，價格合理，陽明和北護學生還有優惠！店員親和力100分😀
reviews.en: Wide range of gear, fair prices, and students from Yang-Ming and NTUNHS get a discount! Staff friendliness: 100 out of 100 😀

reviews.name: Debby Lin
reviews.zh: 我們租的是4人帳篷、桌子、睡墊、冰桶、露營提燈、兩個頭燈、兩張大椅子（很舒服）其他朋友有小羨慕一下 身體整個都包覆及支撐極佳！女老闆解說用心，店內器具非常整潔。租的用具都保養、清潔的很好、無異味。我們帶11月大的寶寶去露營所以很在意清潔度。下次一定會再去租借！
reviews.en: We rented a 4-person tent, table, sleeping pads, cooler, camping lantern, two headlamps and two big chairs (very comfortable — our friends were a bit jealous; they support your whole body). The owner's wife explained everything carefully and the shop is spotless. Everything we rented was well maintained, clean and odour-free. We were camping with our 11-month-old, so cleanliness mattered a lot. We'll definitely rent here again!

reviews.name: 謝沅佑
reviews.zh: 租借睡袋去嘉明湖，當晚背包套都結冰結霜了，我在睡袋裡只穿三件衣服，是很舒服的睡袋～店裡服務專業且良好，重要問題都能詳細對答，價格也很好。下次再來租！
reviews.en: Rented a sleeping bag for Jiaming Lake. That night the pack covers froze over, and I was warm in the bag wearing only three layers — a really comfortable bag. Service is professional and good, every important question got a detailed answer, and the price was great. Will rent again!

reviews.name: Janet Chang
reviews.zh: 老闆娘解說非常清楚！帳篷睡墊都很乾淨無污漬～雖然字面上此為四人帳但其實只能睡兩大一小，此帳篷一個外加三個充氣睡墊780元（清晨有下一小時大雨但帳篷也僅邊緣一點點濕而已）CP值很高～～
reviews.en: The owner's wife explains everything very clearly! Tent and sleeping pads were clean with no stains. The "4-person" tent really sleeps two adults and a child, but the tent plus three inflatable pads was NT$780 (an hour of heavy rain at dawn and only the edges got slightly damp). Excellent value.

reviews.name: Rebecca
reviews.zh: 2023/09來這邊租借第二次了，老闆娘很親切～也都會關心出遊的狀況，提醒我們要注意安全！價格也公開透明而且很便宜！
reviews.en: September 2023, our second time renting here. The owner's wife is lovely — she asks about your trip and reminds you to stay safe! Prices are clearly posted and very cheap.

reviews.name: Roey Wang
reviews.zh: 老闆娘超親切，很認真說明裝備使用方法還有登山的注意事項，不只是一間租借店而已，是個會讓人想要常來租借的店！另外老闆娘都會洗過每次歸還的裝備，覺得很用心，大推。給登山新手又不想花大錢的人建議：登山包可以先用租借，這裡的登山包可以調整背帶高度，女生也能租。百岳住山屋的話，三天兩夜可以租55公升背包；印象中租八借有45、55、75不同種size。
reviews.en: The owner's wife is super friendly and takes real care explaining how the gear works and what to watch out for in the mountains — it's not just a rental shop, it's a place you want to keep coming back to. She washes every piece of gear after it's returned, which shows how much she cares. Highly recommended. Tips for beginners who don't want to spend big: rent your pack first — the packs here have adjustable back lengths, so they fit women too. For a 3-day hut trip on the high peaks, a 55 L pack is enough; as I recall they have 45, 55 and 75 L.

reviews.name: 蔡舒庭
reviews.zh: 第一次辦公司露營，天氣非常糟糕，但是不能取消，又碰到既定廠商爽約，好險找到租八借，設備超級齊全，真的有如甘霖一般神救援，縱使還設備時候泥濘不堪，老闆娘絲毫沒有任何怨言，態度好到我羞愧，謝謝老闆娘，非常謝謝你，如有機會我會再次光臨，也會介紹給親友
reviews.en: Our first company camping trip: terrible weather, couldn't cancel, and our original supplier stood us up. Thank goodness we found 租八借 — fully stocked, an absolute lifesaver. Even though the gear came back caked in mud, the owner's wife didn't complain once; her attitude put me to shame. Thank you so much. I'll be back, and I'll tell friends and family.

reviews.name: 吳詩瑩
reviews.zh: 四月參加第一露，妹妹幫我租了六人帳，帳篷很乾淨，週五租借，週一歸還，也沒被加價，是很佛心也很用心的店家喔！
reviews.en: My first camping trip in April; my sister rented a 6-person tent for me. The tent was very clean. We picked it up Friday and returned it Monday with no extra charge — a kind-hearted, conscientious shop!

reviews.name: 林冠今
reviews.zh: 帳篷乾淨沒有異味 不小心把鋁墊用破損 店家也沒收破損維修費用 服務態度很好！
reviews.en: Tent was clean with no odour. We accidentally damaged the foil groundsheet and they didn't charge us for repairs. Great service!

reviews.name: 李淑君
reviews.zh: 真是一個讓人很舒服的店，店內的裝備整齊又乾淨！闆娘的親和力很棒！其實需要就來借，不要買太多裝備在家！
reviews.en: Such a pleasant shop — the gear is tidy and clean, and the owner's wife is wonderfully approachable. Honestly, just rent what you need instead of buying piles of gear to keep at home!

reviews.name: Sharon Tong
reviews.en: Perfect location, especially if you are in the Beitou area. I rented trekking poles and the nice lady who helped me was very friendly and helpful. The rental price was pretty fair for a quality pair of poles. The rental process was quick and easy, and I was out in less than 10 minutes.
reviews.zh: 地點很方便，尤其是在北投一帶。我租了登山杖，幫我的那位女士非常親切又樂於協助。以一副品質好的登山杖來說，租金相當合理。租借流程快速簡單，不到十分鐘就完成了。

reviews.name: Daisy C. Z.
reviews.en: Location is convenience, can be reached by MRT and a few min walk. I rented a 55L mountain backpack for 7 days, all prices are reasonable and clear. The shop owners were very friendly and kind, spend time answering my questions and explained me what I need to notice when carrying a mountain backpack.
reviews.zh: 地點方便，搭捷運再走幾分鐘就到。我租了一個 55 公升登山背包七天，價格合理又清楚。老闆夫婦非常友善，花時間回答我的問題，並說明背登山包要注意的事。

reviews.name: Sebastian Roth
reviews.en: Very good rental shop. Nice selection, fair prices and friendly staff. Will come back in the future. Thank you!
reviews.zh: 很棒的租借店。選擇多、價格公道、店員友善。以後還會再來，謝謝！

reviews.name: PRAMOD KABBALI
reviews.en: Reasonable price, good quality and prompt service. They dont speak that much English but easy to interact on LINE app. Most of their equipment is listed with pictures on their website.
reviews.zh: 價格合理、品質好、服務迅速。他們英文不太流利，但用 LINE 溝通很容易。大部分裝備都有照片列在網站上。

reviews.name: 王姍姍
reviews.zh: 服務親切，價錢公道！雖然出租的物品都有點老舊，但整理的很乾淨，而且沒異味
reviews.en: Friendly service, fair prices! The rental items are a little old, but they're cleaned up nicely and there's no smell.
